FIELDS.NAME: Eternal Vows Chapel
FIELDS.MAILING ADDRESS: 1234 Blissful Lane, Suite 101, Wedding City, CA 90210-1234
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Eternal Vows Chapel, we specialize in providing a serene and intimate setting for wedding ceremonies. Our operations focus solely on hosting wedding events, offering personalized services that cater to the unique needs of each couple. We provide a beautiful chapel space adorned with stylish décor, ensuring that every ceremony reflects the couple's vision. Our experienced event coordinators assist clients in planning their ideal wedding day, coordinating with third-party vendors such as florists and photographers to ensure a seamless experience. We prioritize safety and legal compliance, requiring all subcontractors to present valid certificates of insurance, and we maintain a strict policy to minimize liability exposure. Additionally, we limit the size of events to ensure a cozy atmosphere and manageable crowd control. With no history of claims or losses in the past five years, we are committed to providing a risk-aware environment for all our clients.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 9 AM - 5 PM; Saturday: 10 AM - 4 PM; Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing and professional watchpersons during events.
